family_description: Repair a published roster after one to three sick calls, minimizing changes and notifying affected employees.
instruction: The published rota needs repair after the sick calls shown in the event inbox. Preserve unaffected assignments where possible, restore legal coverage, and notify each employee whose shift changes. Send roster-change notices to each employee whose shift changes or who is named in a decided request. Include recipient_id, shift_date, shift_type, and ward_id in messaging.send; unrelated messages without those shift fields do not count as roster notifications. This episode accepts at most 3,000 state-changing tool calls and at most 10,000 tool calls in total; plan large rebuilds accordingly. Follow the active written rules, do not claim work is covered unless the roster actually meets its headcount and qualification requirements, and leave the clock records unchanged.
reporting_requirements: Use integer minutes for work and discrepancy totals.
Give a specific reason for each declined swap or uncovered slot.
Report costs in the task currency and do not exceed the agency budget.
title: F02_sick_call_repair: Sick Call Repair
